caption: A pot of potatoes boils with its lid on, and the lid rattles and lifts as steam escapes around its edge.

sa.check: A pot of potatoes boils with its lid on.
The lid rattles: it lifts and drops on its seat.
Steam escapes around the lid's edge.
The lid stays on the pot throughout; it is not removed.

pc.expect: The lid lifts and drops as the puffs of steam push it and settles when the boil eases, and the pot itself stays put.
pc.fail: The lid jumps with no steam escaping anywhere; or the lid lifts and stays up; or the pot slides or turns on the burner with nothing touching it; or the lid rattles while the water below is glassy still.

pc.expect: The steam escapes at the lid's rim and rises, and the lid falls back onto its seat after each lift.
pc.fail: The steam pours down the pot's sides and pools on the hob; or the lid rises and hangs above the pot; or the steam sinks below the pot; or the lid falls upward off the pot.

pc.expect: The rattle goes with the boil: the water churns, bubbles break the surface and steam puffs out as the lid lifts.
pc.fail: The lid rattles while nothing rises below it; or the water churns hard while the lid sits dead still and no steam escapes; or the steam puffs out while the lid is plainly clamped down tight.

pc.expect: The lid stays a rigid disc that knocks on the rim and the potatoes stay firm lumps that jostle in the water.
pc.fail: The lid bends or ripples as it lifts; or a potato dissolves into the water; or the lid sticks to the pot and the pot lifts with it; or the potatoes merge into one lump.

pc.expect: One pot with one lid; the potatoes keep their number and stay in the pot.
pc.fail: A potato vanishes; or a new potato appears; or the lid passes through the pot's rim; or a second lid appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pot, the lid's handle and the hob stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot changes colour; or the lid's handle changes shape; or the hob's knobs move by themselves.

note: The rattle is sound and is not judged; it is read from the lid's visible lifting and dropping.
